sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: traffic signs and signals
Knowledge facts: part C holds 34 fact blocks (sec06-F01 onward) from physical pages 32 to 41; part C2 holds 23 confusable and continuation blocks (sec06-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the back-cover publication line, the two-component structure and the 80 percent per-component passing standard from physical pages 1, 10, 68 and 84; the question count and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- IN-SIGNS-A-COUNT — knowledge-exam question count not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- IN-SIGNS-A-TIME — knowledge-exam time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- IN-SIGNS-D-PERP — unclear stop-position wording when there is no stop line (owner HallucinationAuditor).
- IN-SIGNS-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- IN-SIGNS-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: no fees, phone numbers or service details appear in this chapter; sign and signal rules are treated as stable.

corpus_stability.reason: The Indiana Driver's Manual back cover reads Published July 2026 and tells readers to check IN.gov/BMV for updates; the BMV manual page says printed manuals are updated at most once a year, so the selected pages are treated as stable within a year while fees and service details stay dynamic.
